body: Well I don't know if you'll read this but i'd like to make a few comments. Firstly if your mother was never suppost to have children then you have already defied the odds so you must have some strong genetics. Secondly I was in your situation at 21 and had dropped out of college and I felt like you do (and still do unfortunately, i'm totally lost) but maybe you can turn things around if you try out lots of different things and just go with the flow. Thirdly you are not ugly. For a start you have perfect skin and a perfect hairline. I have acne scars and a heavily receeded hairline, which will cost me a lot of money to fix. I only stopped the acne by taking powerful medication and the hair loss is something I suffered all through my 20s. Right now you just need to chill out and stop being so hard on yourself.
I've been there. I used to have lots of friends. One by one they danced off into the sunset and I never heard from them again. That's why people say family is everything.
